prompt: Build the Balrog from Lord of the Rings — a massive demonic creature of shadow and flame. Towering humanoid demon shape with huge curved horns sweeping back from its head, a snarling beastly face, broad shoulders, muscular arms, and enormous bat-like wings spread wide behind it. It wields a flaming sword in one hand and a fiery whip in the other. The body is dark STONE and COBBLE (shadow/rock), with BRICK and SAND used for glowing lava cracks running through the body, the fiery sword, the whip, and a fiery mane around the head and neck (the Balrog glows with inner fire). LEAVES are NOT appropriate — this is fire and shadow, no green. Make it imposing and unmistakably the Balrog: horns, wings, fire sword, whip, glowing cracks. Face it toward the viewer. Use the full budget for a dramatic, hellish silhouette.
